name: demo-showcase-planning
description: Plan demos + showcases — purpose (discovery / feedback / alignment / sales / celebration), audience, agenda, narrative arc, demo script (golden-path focus), recovery plan if demo fails, environment + data prep, rehearsal cadence, feedback capture mechanism, follow-up actions. Covers sprint review / customer advisory board / investor update / internal show-and-tell. Hand-offs to communication-plan + training-adoption-planning + change-impact-assessment.
